arguments.content:
import json, sys, subprocess

cursor = ""
for i in range(15):
    url = "https://slack.com/api/conversations.list?token=<TOKEN>&exclude_archived=true&limit=1000&types=public_channel"
    if cursor:
        url += "&cursor=" + cursor
    r = subprocess.run(["curl", "-s", "-X", "POST", url], capture_output=True, text=True)
    d = json.loads(r.stdout)
    if not d.get("ok"):
        print("ERROR:", d.get("error"))
        sys.exit(1)
    for c in d["channels"]:
        topic = c.get("topic", {}).get("topic", "")
        print(f"{c['id']}\t{c['name']}\t{topic}\tarchived={c.get('is_archived', False)}")
    cursor = d.get("response_metadata", {}).get("next_cursor", "")
    if not cursor:
        break
